## LmdbBackup class

Timestamped backup lifecycle over LMDB envs — create, list, prune, restore, archive, upload, and schedule.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class LmdbBackup 
```

## Remarks

Dir backups are plain directories (`backup-<stamp>` holding `data.mdb`<!-- -->), so restore is a copy and inspection needs no tooling. Tar.gz archives need the optional `tar` peer; S3 upload needs the optional `@aws-sdk/client-s3` peer — both load lazily, so installs without them pay nothing and only those two paths throw (`LmdbError`<!-- -->) when missing. Only `backup-*` entries are ever listed or pruned — foreign files in the directory are left alone.
